title: RFK Jr promises anti-vaccine activists a 'friend at the White House' amid ongoing measles outbreak
detail: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. spoke at the Children's Health Defense conference, promising anti-vaccine activists a 'friend at the White House' while the US continues to experience a deadly measles outbreak. The remarks underscore ongoing tensions between the administration's public health posture and vaccination advocacy.

media.caption: RFK Jr speaks at Children's Health Defense conference during measles outbreak
